slides.title: Is willpower *really limited?*
slides.sub: What a set of Stanford experiments found.

slides.title: The question
slides.body: Stanford researchers ran four experiments on students' beliefs about willpower. Is it a limited resource that runs out, or not?

slides.title: What they found
slides.body: After a tiring task, students who believed willpower is limited, or were led to believe it, did worse on concentration tests.

slides.title: One honest limit
slides.body: These were experiments with college students. It's a finding about beliefs, not proof that you never need rest.

slides.title: Check the story.
slides.body: Next time you think "I'm out of willpower," ask: am I actually tired, or just telling myself I'm done?
